spec.query: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN (${service:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time
spec.exemplarQuery: SELECT Timestamp AS time, Duration / 1e6 AS value, ServiceName, TraceId AS trace_id FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 100
